style.title: Minecraft-like
style.resolution: 16x16 for blocks and items; isometric block previews compose three 16x16 faces into 32x32
style.perspective: front-facing flat tile for individual block faces; isometric ~30deg cube preview when showing top, front, and side together
style.outlines: no explicit outlines — shapes are defined by adjacent color blocks; items may have an implicit 1px darker border created by texture, not a drawn line
style.lighting: flat unshaded pixel grid with at most 2-3 brightness steps per material; top face is brightest, front face mid-tone, side face slightly darker; no specular highlights
style.palette: small high-saturation per-material palette (typically 4-6 colors per block); iron silver-gray, gold rich yellow, diamond bright cyan, redstone red, dirt warm brown, stone neutral gray, grass top vivid green, nether deep red
style.rendering: raw 16x16 pixel grid, no anti-aliasing, no smoothing, no dithering, no gradient ramps; each pixel is a single solid color
style.detail_density: low — coarse noise patterns and a few accent pixels per face, never fine line art
style.shape_language: perfectly square tiles that tile seamlessly with themselves on all edges; no object silhouette, no centered icon; the entire 16x16 is filled edge-to-edge with material
style.notes: Minecraft blocks are seamless tileable 16x16 material textures. Isometric block previews stack a 16x16 top diamond on top of left (front) and right (side) parallelograms. Items keep the same 16x16 grid but show a centered silhouette.
